mcq.q: Which surah says "Say: He is Allah, the One"?
mcq.explanation: These are the first words of Al-Ikhlas.

mcq.q: Which surah has only three verses?
mcq.explanation: An-Nasr is the shortest of the seven surahs in this lesson, with three verses.

mcq.q: What does Surah Al-Ikhlas teach us most?
options: Allah is One and has no equal
mcq.explanation: The surah declares the oneness of Allah.

mcq.q: Which surah is number 112 in the Qur'an?
mcq.explanation: Al-Ikhlas is surah 112, Al-Falaq 113 and An-Naas 114.

mcq.q: What is a single verse of the Qur'an called?
mcq.explanation: Ayah (plural ayat) means verse; a chapter is a surah.

mcq.q: "Alhamdu lillahi Rabbil-'alamin" means
options: Say: He is Allah, the One
All praise belongs to Allah, Lord of all the worlds
I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
mcq.explanation: This is the second verse of Al-Fatiha.

mcq.q: What does "akhlaq" mean?
What does Islam teach about lying, even in jokes?
options: The Prophet avoided lying even in jokes

mcq.q: Who is the best example of good character for Muslims?
mcq.explanation: The Qur'an praises his great character.

mcq.q: Why did people leave their valuables with Muhammad (S.A.W.) before Islam?
options: Because he lived in the mountain

mcq.q: In the hadith about eating, from which part of the dish should we eat?
options: The part directly in front of us
mcq.explanation: The hadith says "eat what is directly in front of you".

mcq.q: Why do we wash our hands before eating?
options: To keep food and ourselves clean
mcq.explanation: Cleanliness is part of good manners and health.

mcq.q: Who was the boy taught the manners of eating in the hadith?
mcq.explanation: He lived in the Prophet's home.

mcq.q: What is the meaning of "adab of eating"?
options: The etiquette or good manners of eating

mcq.q: Which of these is a good time to use the siwak?
mcq.explanation: The Prophet encouraged it before prayers.

mcq.q: What is oral hygiene?
options: Keeping the mouth and teeth clean

mcq.q: What should we say before brushing?
mcq.explanation: Bismillah is said before good acts.

mcq.q: Why is it good to have fresh breath when praying and meeting people?
options: It is respectful to Allah and to others

mcq.q: Which value is learned from team games?
Which greeting should players give at the end of a match?
mcq.explanation: Respect and greetings are Islamic manners.

mcq.q: The Prophet (S.A.W.) is reported to have raced with which wife?
A game is permitted in Islam if
options: It is safe, fair and does not stop us from prayer

mcq.q: What does "As-Salam" mean?
mcq.explanation: As-Salam is free of all faults and gives peace.

mcq.q: According to the hadith, how many names does Allah have that whoever learns and understands them is rewarded?
mcq.explanation: The hadith speaks of ninety-nine names.

mcq.q: Rain that falls on farms of everyone is a sign of which name?
Kevin returns a lost charger when nobody sees him. Which belief helped him?
Which of these is a mistake about Allah's names?
options: Thinking Allah is like a human being

mcq.q: Which angel brings revelation to the prophets?
mcq.explanation: Jibril brought the Qur'an to the Prophet.

mcq.q: What is the duty of Raqib and Atid?
mcq.explanation: They write what a person says and does.

mcq.q: Why did Allah create angels?
options: To worship Him and carry out His orders

mcq.q: What is the correct way to mention an angel's name?
mcq.explanation: We say peace be upon him.

mcq.q: Which is a wrong belief about angels?
options: That they are made of light

mcq.q: How many prophets are named in the Qur'an, as taught at Grade 4?
Which prophet is remembered for generosity to guests?
mcq.explanation: He served his guests a fattened calf.

mcq.q: Who was the brother who helped Prophet Musa?
mcq.explanation: Harun was Musa's brother and helper.

mcq.q: What is patience?
options: Staying calm and trusting Allah in hardship

mcq.q: Which prophet's story shows a person who refused wrongdoing and feared Allah?
Which of these is a najasa?
mcq.explanation: Urine must be washed off before prayer.

mcq.q: What is a mughalladha najasa?
What is the main tool for removing najasaat?
mcq.explanation: Allah sends pure water from the sky.

mcq.q: A baby girl's urine falls on a mat. What type of najasa is it?
mcq.explanation: Baby girl's urine is washed as medium najasa in this teaching.

mcq.q: What should you do after cleaning a najasa?
mcq.explanation: Wash hands with soap and water.

mcq.q: What is mud on your clothes?
mcq.explanation: Mud is not najasa though we clean for neatness.

mcq.q: Which body part is wiped, not washed?
Which of these breaks wudhu?
mcq.explanation: Anything from the front or back passage breaks wudhu.

mcq.q: Which health benefit does wudhu give?
options: It removes germs from exposed body parts

mcq.q: Which of these shows waste in wudhu?
mcq.explanation: Islam teaches us not to waste water.

mcq.q: What is a condition of swalah?
options: Something needed before the prayer starts
mcq.explanation: Conditions come before the prayer begins.

mcq.q: In which direction does the sun rise?
mcq.explanation: The sun rises in the east.

mcq.q: Which prayer is prayed at dawn?
How many rak'ahs does Dhuhr have?
What is tayammum?
options: Using clean earth when water cannot be used
mcq.explanation: It is a substitute in some cases.

mcq.q: What should a traveller do if unable to know the Qibla exactly?
options: Try their best and Allah accepts it
mcq.explanation: Allah does not burden beyond ability.

mcq.q: What is takbiratul ihram?
options: Saying "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer

mcq.q: How many parts of the body touch the ground in sujud?
mcq.explanation: Forehead, two palms, two knees, toes of both feet.

mcq.q: How many sujud are in each rak'ah?
What did the Prophet tell the man who prayed in a hurry?
Which posture is closest to Allah, according to the Prophet?
mcq.explanation: A servant is closest in sujud.

mcq.q: When is the last tashahhud recited?
Which is a way of showing kindness to a working donkey?
How can we help birds in the dry season?
options: Put out water in a dish

mcq.q: Which is a safe practice around stray dogs?
options: Do not go near them and tell an adult

mcq.q: What does the Qur'an say about everything in the heavens and earth?
Which of these fits the Islamic code of dressing?
What should we say when dressing?
Which is an example of wasteful dressing?
options: Buying many clothes you do not need

mcq.q: Which of these is print media?
mcq.explanation: Print media is printed on paper.

mcq.q: What is cyberbullying?
options: Hurting others with messages or online posts

mcq.q: What should come before screen time?
options: Prayer, homework and helping at home

mcq.q: Which of these is a mobile phone use that follows Islamic manners?
options: Calling a relative to greet them

mcq.q: What is begging?
options: Asking for money or things without real need

mcq.q: Which is an evil of begging?
What does Qur'an 62:10 tell us after prayer?
options: Spread through the land and seek Allah's bounty

mcq.q: What is sadaqah?
Which verse says "Call upon Me, I will respond to you"?
What does the dua for leaving the house mean?
options: In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
In the name of Allah we enter

mcq.q: What do we say at the end of a dua?
When should you say the dua for leaving?
options: As you step out of the door

mcq.q: Who is a shepherd responsible for his flock according to the hadith?
options: Every person responsible for those in his care

mcq.q: What does Qur'an 66:6 tell believers?
What does spending on family for Allah's pleasure count as?
What is the dua for parents?
mcq.explanation: A dua asking mercy for parents.

mcq.q: Even if parents command wrong, what should we do?
options: Still treat them kindly in worldly matters

mcq.q: Why are parents to be respected?
options: They sacrifice time, energy and money for us

mcq.q: Who is a "shangazi"?
What is the extended family?
Which action helps keep family ties?
How can you keep in touch with a relative far away?
options: Call, send a message or a gift

mcq.q: In which city was Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) born?
Which surah contains the first five verses revealed?
What does "Qalam" mean?
What did the Prophet say when the angel told him to read?
Who was the Prophet's close friend who believed at once?
How did Khadija support the Prophet?
Who was the first Caliph?
mcq.explanation: Abu Bakr led the Muslims after the Prophet.

mcq.q: Which quality did the early converts show?
What is the period of Khadija's and Abu Talib's deaths called?
What did the angel of the mountains offer?
options: To crush the people between two mountains

mcq.q: What happened to Taif later?
options: Its people accepted Islam in later years

mcq.q: Whose protection did the Prophet enter Makkah under after Taif?

short.q: Describe the manners a Muslim should follow when reading the Qur'an.
short.answer: Be clean and make wudhu if possible, sit calmly, seek Allah's protection from Shaytan and say Bismillah, and read slowly and clearly with tajweed.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct manner, up to 3.

short.q: State two lessons from Surah An-Nasr.
short.answer: We should thank Allah and be humble when we succeed, and ask His forgiveness.
short.working: 1 mark for each lesson.

short.q: Explain the meaning of the hadith "I have been sent for the purpose of perfecting good morals".
short.answer: The Prophet's mission included completing and perfecting good character. Good manners are part of the faith and must be practised every day.
short.working: 1 mark for perfecting good morals, 1 mark for part of faith, 1 mark for daily practice.

short.q: Why is it wrong to pray on time but shout at your family?
short.answer: Islam teaches that faith includes good manners. The Prophet was sent to perfect good morals, so prayer and character go together.
short.working: 1 mark for faith including manners, 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the conclusion.

short.q: Describe three good manners of eating apart from saying Bismillah.
short.answer: Wash hands before, eat with the right hand, eat from in front, do not criticise food, do not waste.
short.working: 1 mark for each manner.

short.q: Describe what a siwak is and how it is used.
short.answer: It is a small stick from a tree such as the arak. One end is chewed to make fibres, and it is rubbed on the teeth.
short.working: 1 mark for stick or tree, 1 mark for chewing the end, 1 mark for rubbing the teeth.

short.q: Explain how brushing teeth can be an act of ibadah.
short.answer: Brush with the intention of following the Sunnah, and to keep clean for prayer. Allah rewards good intentions. We keep the body pure and please Allah.
short.working: 1 mark for intention, 1 mark for following the Sunnah, 1 mark for keeping clean for prayer, 1 mark for reward.

short.q: Explain how physical fitness helps a Muslim in worship and in daily life.
short.answer: It makes prayer postures, fasting and walking to the mosque easier. It also gives strength for work and helping others.
short.working: 2 marks for worship points and 2 marks for daily life points.

short.q: Give the meanings of As-Salam, As-Sami' and Al-Basir.
short.answer: As-Salam: the Source of Peace; As-Sami': the All-Hearing; Al-Basir: the All-Seeing.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Describe how each of the six names studied should change our behaviour.
short.answer: Ar-Rahman: be merciful to all; Ar-Rahim: forgive others; Al-Malik: use things well; As-Salam: bring peace; As-Sami': make dua and speak well; Al-Basir: be honest in private.
short.working: 1 mark for each correct name with matching behaviour up to 5.

short.q: Give three effects of belief in angels on a Muslim's life.
short.answer: More honesty, more thankfulness, respect for the Qur'an, remembering death and the Day of Judgement.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid effect.

short.q: Write any ten prophets mentioned in the Qur'an.
short.answer: Any ten of Adam, Idris, Nuh, Hud, Salih, Ibrahim, Lut, Ismail, Ishaq, Yaqub, Yusuf, Ayyub, Shuayb, Musa, Harun, Dhul-Kifl, Dawud, Sulaiman, Ilyas, Al-Yasa, Yunus, Zakariyya, Yahya, Isa, Muhammad.
short.working: Half a mark for each name up to 5 marks.

short.q: Explain how Ibrahim and Ismail (A.S.) showed obedience to Allah.
short.answer: Ibrahim was told in a dream to sacrifice his son, Ismail said to do as commanded and that he would be patient, and both were ready. Allah replaced Ismail with a ram.
short.working: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for Ismail's reply, 1 mark for readiness, 1 mark for the ram.

short.q: Distinguish between physical and spiritual purity.
short.answer: Physical purity is cleaning body, clothes and place from najasaat. Spiritual purity is cleaning the heart from envy, pride and hatred.
short.working: 1 mark for physical, 1 mark for spiritual, 1 mark for an example.

short.q: Give two items used in purification of najasaat.
short.answer: Water, soil, soap, clean cloth.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: State three things that nullify wudhu.
short.answer: Urine, stool or wind; deep sleep lying down; fainting.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Halima made wudhu for Fajr. Later she took a short nap sitting up and then passed wind. Is her wudhu valid? Explain.
short.answer: Her nap sitting up did not break wudhu, but passing wind did. So her wudhu is broken and she must make it again.
short.working: 1 mark for the nap, 1 mark for wind, 1 mark for broken, 1 mark for making wudhu again.

short.q: State two ways to know the times of prayer.
short.answer: Adhan, printed mosque timetable, prayer app, watching the sun.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pillars of swalah from ruku up to taslim.
short.answer: Ruku, rising from ruku, sujud, sitting between the sujud, last sitting, tashahhud, blessings on the Prophet, taslim.
short.working: Award 1 mark for each two correct pillars up to 4 and 1 mark for correct order.

short.q: Describe one complete rak'ah in order.
short.answer: Stand and recite Al-Fatiha, bow, rise, first sujud, sit, second sujud, then stand or sit for tashahhud.
short.working: 1 mark for each pair of steps.

short.q: Explain why we should be kind to Allah's creatures.
short.answer: Allah made them and owns them; kindness earns mercy and reward; animals help us; kindness makes us kind to people.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.

short.q: State four features of the Islamic code of dressing.
short.answer: Cover the awrah, loose and not see-through, clean and neat, not for showing off, no rude words or pictures.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Name three types of media and give one example of each.
short.answer: Print: newspaper; broadcast: radio; internet: video website.
short.working: 1 mark for each type with example.

short.q: Write a media plan for a week for a Grade 4 child following Islamic manners.
short.answer: Screen time limit after homework; no screens at prayer or meal times; educational and Islamic content; ask permission; tell an adult if unsafe.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid item up to 5.

short.q: Explain what the Prophet taught about cutting and selling firewood.
short.answer: Honest work, even hard work like cutting and selling firewood, is better than asking people who may give or refuse.
short.working: 1 mark for honest work, 1 mark for firewood, 1 mark for better than begging.

short.q: Write the meaning of the dua for entering the house.
short.answer: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
short.working: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

short.q: What does it mean that children are an amanah?
short.answer: A trust from Allah that parents must look after.
short.working: 1 mark for trust and 1 mark for parents' care.

short.q: Give three ways of thanking your parents for their care.
short.answer: Say thank you, make dua for them, obey in good, help at home, behave well.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: State four duties of children to their parents.
short.answer: Obey in good, respect, thank and make dua, help at home, care for them when old, be honest.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write a short thank-you note to a parent with two promises about helping at home.
short.answer: A polite note thanking the parent for specific things, and two clear promises such as washing dishes and doing homework early.
short.working: 1 mark for greeting and thanks, 2 marks for specific thanks, 2 marks for two promises.

short.q: Explain why keeping family ties is important.
short.answer: It is Allah's command, it brings love, unity and support, brings blessing and is an act of worship.
short.working: 1 mark for each valid reason.

short.q: Describe what happened when Jibril came to the Prophet in the cave.
short.answer: Jibril told him to read, he said he could not read, Jibril pressed him and repeated three times, then recited the first verses.
short.working: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for reply, 1 mark for three times and recitation.

short.q: Explain how a Grade 4 child can apply the command "Iqra".
short.answer: Read and study daily, ask teachers questions, use safe sources to learn, share knowledge with others.
short.working: 1 mark for each of four ways.

short.q: Explain the role of Abu Bakr (R.A.) in the growth of Islam.
short.answer: He believed at once, invited others, spent his wealth freeing believers, and was the Prophet's companion in the cave.
short.working: 1 mark for each of four roles.

short.q: Narrate briefly what happened to the Prophet in Taif.
short.answer: He invited the leaders and they rejected him rudely, some people threw stones at him and Zayd, his feet bled, and he took shelter in a garden and made dua.
short.working: 1 mark for each of four points.

short.q: Suggest four situations in which a Grade 4 child needs patience, tolerance or perseverance.
short.answer: Being teased, failing a test, a friend refusing to play, being sick, dealing with a rude neighbour.
short.working: 1 mark for each suitable situation.
